findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "verify_catch" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "register_customer" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_catalog, get_catch_reports, get_share_kit · Private data: get_catalog, get_contact_info, get_catch_reports, verify_catch, verify_temp, get_komon_records, verify_komon, contact_gyotak, recover_customer_key, apply_referrer, my_referrals, report_share · Public sink: place_order, contact_gyotak, register_customer, apply_referrer, get_share_kit, report_share · Destructive: confirm_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_catalog, get_catch_reports, get_share_kit · Private data: get_catalog, get_contact_info, get_catch_reports, verify_catch, verify_temp, get_komon_records, verify_komon, contact_gyotak, recover_customer_key, apply_referrer, my_referrals, report_share · Public sink: place_order, contact_gyotak, register_customer, apply_referrer, get_share_kit, report_share · Destructive: confirm_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
